training.timing_note: Original geometry run reports elapsed time after resume from step 2000. Parallel ablations and evaluation had independent CUDA memory budgets, so these times are not hardware benchmarks.

evaluation.denominator: Signed differences of pooled PSNR. Per-scene efficiency needs candidate gain >=0.3 dB. Raw pooled ratio and candidate coverage retain sign; negative headroom is not a recoverable fraction.
evaluation.actual_oracle: One supported positive candidate per query, highest K16 hit fraction and sorted-order tiebreak. Unavailable GT placement or color is tracked separately. Candidate comes from the same eight observations used by inference.
evaluation.same_candidate_ablation: R1+R2 on D uses the same eight candidates, O1 ordering and F2 background as learned. System R1+R2 uses A and the full geometry-specific rule pool.
evaluation.query_definitions: All method-band queries include empty queries. Correctness = K16 world-point match; selection = top weighted candidate on GT-supported heads; active = any predicted alpha > 0.1; hidden need = at least one mesh-labeled hidden ray at the query pixel.

notes.source_frame_distribution: all labeled correct observations in the packed query, may count repeat use
notes.cause_order: one recoverable K16 witness per in-band missing pixel; reasons are exclusive proxies
notes.edge_mixing_diagnostic: all feasible witnesses near their predicted source depth edge; mixing risk proxy
notes.upstream_geometry: G3 two r14 provenance pools reused; G2 inputs replayed with original and official DepthSplat geometry
notes.R3_default_cache: DepthSplat candidates already regenerated from this geometry and available before R3
notes.pilot_source_geometry: The three representative input views reuse T4 dominant/DepthSplat depths. The original comparison uses calibrated SHARP depth at other input frames. The DepthSplat comparison runs the official depth checkpoint at those frames, with the same input-only consistency and registered-static validity rules.
